translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Yaubada ikabutu baisa Eberam
Oluvi Eberam igisi kilisala, e ilagi Guyau iluki matauna, kawala, “Mwa! Eberam, taga bukukokola. Bogwa bakolaim mwada gala avai kabosilagi biyogagaim, e basakaim kam mapu kwaiveka.”
Mitaga Eberam ivitakauloki, kawala, “Mwa! Guyau Yaubada, ki, m mapu makwaina avaka kala bwaina baisa yeigu? Paila gala isim litugwa. Ka, taitala wala bikau kaikeyagu, matauwena Eliesa guma Damasiko.
Yoku gala kusakaigu litugwa, e taitala ulo ula bikau kaikeyagu.”
E ilagi Guyau ilukivau matauna, kawala, “Ka, matauna Eliesa m ula gala wala bikau kaikeyam, paila latum tatoum wala bikau makwaina.”
E Guyau ivakouli matauna isunapulasi okoukweda, e ikaibiga, kawala, “Kumitakavati labuma. Kuvigikoni bukukwalau kasi bawa utuyam. Paila ka, tubumwa bidalasi kasi bawa makawala minasina.”
Eberam idubumi Guyau e mauula iyomwasali nanola e Guyau ikabwaili matauna.
E Guyau iluki matauna, kawala, “Yeigu wala Guyau yeigula lavisunupuloiyaim metoya Ura mapilana Babilonia, e lasakaim makwaina valu, lavigaki makawala m vavagi titoulem.”
Mitaga ivitakauloki matauna, kawala, “Guyau Yaubada, ammakawala gagabila banikoli kidamwa baisa ulo vavagi tatougu?”
Iluki matauna, kawala, “Kumiakaigu natana bulumakau, natana gota, deli natana sipi namwala, natana natana kasi taitu kwaitolu, e deli natana bubunerora, e natana bubuna.”
Eberam imai komwaidona minasina baisa Yaubada. Oluvi itaviki pilayu, e itakasi kasayu. Mitaga bubuna gala wala itavi.
Deli avai tuta mluveka italakapusisi mwada bikomasi minasina, Eberam ibokavili ilosi.
E avai tuta kalasia bogwa bisalili, Eberam ikenu imisiwoya wala, e kabovitukokola ibusi baisa matauna e ikokoluvagasi.
E Guyau ikaibiga baisa matauna, kawala, “Igau makateki dalem bivagaisi gilagala baisa valu ituwoli. Deli, bivigakaisi si ula, deli si sisu mwau sainela taitu kala bawa kwelakatuvasi.
Mitaga igau bamipuki kabokwaraiwaga makwaina availa eivaulaisi matausina. E avai tuta bisilavaisi makwaina valu, bikauwaisi bidubadu veiguwa deli matausina.
Pailaga yoku bukusisu wala bila bibodi kam tomoya mokwita, e bukukwaliga bogwala lokukwam kalagila vakota e bibakwaimsi.
Makawala tubuvasisi biwokuva e oluviga bikeiitasi baisa, paila yeigu gala babokavili mina Amora bisunapulasi igau wala saina bimitugagasi e ibodi bibanaisi mipuki.”
E kalasia bogwa isalili, e idudubila, kubowala kulia deli visigala kova, e kaitapa ilululu, saina nanakwa iyoumatilasi e ilosi oluwalaisi makasasina mauna.
E, tuta matutowena goli, mapilana valu Yaubada ikabutu baisa Eberam,
e iluki, kawala, “Bogwa lakatotila igau dalem biyoulisi pwaipwaia okaligeila Itipita bila bila ee - kaduyoveka waya Yupereiti e baisa bitobu.
Makawala wala si valu mina Keini, mina Kenisi, mina Kadimoni,
mina Itai, mina Peresi, mina Repa,
mina Amora, mina Kenani, mina Gigasa, e mina Yebusi."
